what: Who stands in the lineup (Session 9, as Christian approved it), the judge whose grades are its scores, the second opinion, which side-by-sides it shows, and the judge that was replaced. Scores never come from here: they come from the judged runs in runs/ (scripts/export-runs.mjs reads both). When a run is judged, only data changes.

second_opinion.why: gpt-6-luna graded the models not made by OpenAI before Claude Haiku 5.5 took over. Christian kept its grades as a second opinion, to show how much the judge moves a score.

pairs.why: The same model twice: once told to always sound sure and never admit it doesn't know, once as it comes. It isn't ranked: it's here to show what instructions alone do.
Two generations of the same family at the same size. Gemma 4 thinks before it answers, by default.

replaced_judges.why: Christian had another Claude chat review all 59 verdicts Qwen3.6 35B marked as caught on the OpenAI bots. It found about two in three wrong, such as true facts called lies. Claude Haiku 5.5 replaced it, and grades every model. Qwen's grades don't count.
